item.title: Cavaliers’ Donovan Mitchell named NBA All-Star; LeBron James’ All-Star streak at 22 years
item.description: LeBron James is an All-Star again, extending his record streak of selections. James was a pick for the 22nd consecutive year, one of 14 players who were announced Feb. 1 as reserves for the Feb. 15 midseason showcase that’ll take place at the Los Angeles Clippers’ arena in Inglewood, California. item.title: Cleveland State men win fourth in a row, 90-88, over Milwaukee
item.description: Jaidon Lipscomb scored 21 points, including the go-ahead free throws with 1 second remaining, and Cleveland State defeated Milwaukee, 90-88, on Feb. 1. The Vikings (9-14, 5-7 Horizon) swept the weekend Wisconsin road trip and have won four in a row. Dayan Nessah added 19 points and 13 rebounds, Chevalier Emery scored 17 points, and Tre Beard had 15. Cleveland State returns to the Wolstein Center on Feb. 4 to host Oakland.

item.title: Jarrett Allen scores career-high 40 points as the Cavaliers beat the Trail Blazers, 130-111
item.description: By ANNE M. PETERSON PORTLAND, Ore. — Jarrett Allen scored a career-high 40 points and grabbed 17 rebounds as the Cleveland Cavaliers handed the Portland Trail Blazers their fifth straight loss with a 130-111 victory Sunday night. Sam Merrill added 22 points, including six 3-pointers, and the Cavs rebounded from a loss to the Phoenix Suns on Friday night that snapped a five-game winning streak.
